//: The nightly database backup: a scheduled Railway service, same repository and Dockerfile, that runs ops/management/commands/backup_database.py and exits.
To create it: Railway > New > GitHub Repo > this repository, then in the service's Settings set Root Directory to `backend` and Config-as-code path to `railway.backup.json`.

Variables it needs: DATABASE_URL, DJANGO_SECRET_KEY, BACKUP_S3_BUCKET (a PRIVATE bucket, not the media one) and the keys for it (BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID / BACKUP_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT_URL, or the AWS_* set of the media bucket when it is the same storage account). Also the EMAIL_* set, so the admins are e-mailed when a backup fails, and SENTRY_DSN, so Sentry notices when a night is missed altogether.
docs/BACKUPS.md has the whole set-up and how to restore a backup.

deploy.//schedule: 03:00 UTC every night, when nobody is working. Keep SCHEDULE in backup_database.py the same, so Sentry knows when to expect it.
deploy.//restartPolicy: NEVER: a scheduled job is meant to exit. A failed run is reported (e-mail, Sentry, the System page) and the next night tries again.
